messages.subject: Multiple instances
parts:
I have Shiny server running on an Ubuntu Server 12.04 LTS. I used the quick start instructions to set it up and it works just fine.

Is it possible to run multiple instances of shiny server on the same Ubuntu server? For example, can I have one running on say port 3839 in addition to the default one on 3838?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Multiple instances
parts:
Yes, you need to create multiple config files and pass it as the first argument to shiny-server. Your second config file can use port 3839.

Note that you can also configure one Shiny Server instance to listen on multiple ports. See the config docs.
